target.title: Show claude-swap model-scoped weekly windows
target.body:
## Summary

- Parse optional schema-v1 `usage.scoped` model windows from the bounded `cswap --list --json` adapter.
- Ignore malformed or future scoped rows without losing valid 5-hour or 7-day account windows.
- Reuse Claude's existing scoped-weekly mapper so cards render stable `Fable only` rows, percentages, and resets.
- Expand the adapter contract docs and add synthetic before/after menu-card proof.

## Security and compatibility

- Schema-v1 validation, fixed process arguments, bounded output, timeout behavior, account identity, and opt-in gating are unchanged.
- Scoped names remain display-only. They are never account identity and do not affect switching.
- No real account, credential, browser, or Keychain access was used.

## Verification

- `swift test --filter 'ClaudeSwapListParserTests|ClaudeSwapAccountProjectionTests|ClaudeSwapAccountReaderTests|MenuCardClaudeSwapAccountTests'` — 35 tests passed across 4 suites.
- Fake-executable reader fixture — exact `--list --json` invocation parsed the synthetic Fable scoped row.
- `make check` — documentation links, SwiftFormat, and SwiftLint passed; 0 violations.
- Autoreview — code and docs changes clean; no actionable findings.

## Visual proof

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before: claude-swap card with account-wide windows only](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/CodexBar/5a91d092294452d76fd023b015fc050c9a16797e/docs/screenshots/claude-swap-scoped-before.png) | ![After: claude-swap card with Fable scoped weekly window](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/CodexBar/5a91d092294452d76fd023b015fc050c9a16797e/docs/screenshots/claude-swap-scoped-after.png) |

Closes #2304

target.title: Add daily cost and plan usage history for OpenCode Go
target.body: ## Summary - Adds a "Plan Usage" row (hover-expands into 5-hour / weekly / monthly rate-limit history, 3 tabs) for the OpenCode Go provider, matching Codex/Claude's structure. - Adds a "Cost" row (hover-expands into a daily $ spend chart, reusing the same `CostHistoryChartMenuView` Codex/Claude use) sourced from the local `opencode-go` SQLite history at `~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db`. - The web-sourced fetch strategy best-effort enriches its rolling/weekly percentages with the local daily buckets, since opencode.ai's web API has no daily-granularity endpoint — but skips that local read when the user explicitly selects Web-only source mode, so that choice is actually honored. - Fixes a couple of latent bugs found while wiring this up: the merged "Overview" row was showing the Cost chart instead of Plan Usage for OpenCode Go, and the daily chart's request count could overcount turns whose cost is split across multiple `step-finish` parts. ## Screenshots Plan usage pane Cost pane Inline graph ## Test plan - [x] `swift build` (CodexBar, CodexBarCore, CodexBarCLI) — clean - [x] New unit tests: local SQLite day-bucketing/window clamp, request-count dedup, Overview-row submenu routing, Plan Usage series for opencodego, menu row ordering (Usage pane → Plan Usage → Cost) - [x] Full `swift test` suite — all tests touching the changed files pass; the only failures are pre-existing timing-sensitive PTY/Keychain tests unrelated to this diff - [x] `swiftformat --lint` / `swiftlint` clean on all touched files - [x] Manually verified in a packaged, signed `CodexBar.app` build against a real `opencode-go` local database Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5
